parameters.content:
## Answer

App sends the student's question plus excerpts it already read from Postgres. n8n runs the model and returns the answer text.

### The prompt lives in Build Prompt

Edit the wording there on the canvas - no redeploy needed. That is why generation sits in n8n rather than in the app.

### Do not fetch anything here

The excerpts arrive already filtered by the student's own database permissions. This workflow must only format what it was given. Adding a Supabase lookup would route around that check.

### Excerpt order is load-bearing

The app maps `[1]`, `[2]` in the answer back to chunk ids **by position**. Never reorder or drop excerpts in Build Prompt.

### Turn off execution saving

Workflow Settings → save successful production executions **off**. Otherwise every answer stores a copy of the student's project text in n8n history.
